# MAPF 两条研究支线

GitHub入口与 [项目README](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/main/README.md) 一致。2026-10-18起采用SCI小论文与硕士论文两条线，共享必要底座；旧“四分支只服务一个误差问题”不再适用。

- [唯一当前研究决定](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/main/docs/RESEARCH_PLAN.md)
- [SCI支线](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/research/sci-mapf/tracks/sci/README.md)
- [硕士论文支线](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/research/thesis-integration/tracks/thesis/README.md)
- [最新进度](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/main/GITHUB_PROGRESS.md) · [导航](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/main/REPOSITORY_NAVIGATION.md)

最新SCI六项16/32车诊断全部完成、零重试，三项有微小SOC改善，见[535ee1a结果](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/535ee1adf3135ab79565e0b3aa5d189348fe7ab2/tracks/sci/PROFILE_RESULT.md)。硕士[32db58f](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/32db58f1cd4c45b905b5557a26203a31bf49b7d8/tracks/thesis/README.md)通过固定提交离线解析全部路径：三个改善案例转向量增加，尚非物理执行结果。后继先补共同工程基座/完整ADDRESS对照及运动适配，不训练。

四次旧闭式功能DEV全部SUCCESS、枚举收益为零，见[原始依据](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/ae058c5025eaaa61a424ef7627515d40c2e83997/exploration/spatial_constraints_s1_20261016/PREEXECUTION_DEV_RESULT.md)。SCI第一批8车六臂由经典下界解释全部搜索减少、路径质量不变，见[结果](https://github.com/LYHrmer/MAPF_PIED_MDDR_RESEARCH/blob/c0bd1345b8e192380ce2b1313e11475b54bbfa3d/tracks/sci/DEV_RESULT.md)。上述所有批次许可均已消费，不恢复旧查询学习。
